_written: 2026-10-14, BEFORE any gen41 return was computed.
goal: steady monthly-recurring edge on MT5 index CFDs, usable alone or next to crypto C*
data: Yahoo daily closes of 11 cash indices (US500 US100 US30 US2000 DE40 UK100 JP225 FR40 EU50 AU200 HK50), 2000-01 .. 2026-10-13; each index on its own trading calendar

hypotheses (literature, parameters fixed.A1_TURN_OF_MONTH: long from the close of the 2nd-to-last trading day of each month to the close of the 3rd trading day of the next month (i.e. holds the last trading day + first 3 days; Lakonishok-Smidt 1988, McConnell-Xu 2008); flat otherwise
hypotheses (literature, parameters fixed.A2_TOM_TREND: A1 only when the index closed above its 200-day moving average at entry
hypotheses (literature, parameters fixed.A3_PRE_HOLIDAY: long for the trading day before each exchange holiday (gap of > 1 business day in the index's own calendar, excluding weekends); flat otherwise
hypotheses (literature, parameters fixed.A4_FIRST_HALF_MONTH: long trading days 1..10 of each month only (control for semi-monthly effect; Ariel 1987)

portfolio: equal-weight across the 11 indices (each index position 1/11 of the book when active), vol-scaled to 10% annual on DEV
costs: index CFD: 2 bp per side + 3%/yr financing on exposure days; stress 2x
acceptance per hypothesis: net Sharpe >= 0.4 DEV, >= 0.3 VAL, >= 0.3 TEST, 2x-stress TEST >= 0.2, Holm-adjusted bootstrap p < 0.05 over the 4, AND positive net Sharpe in >= 8 of the 11 indices over 2000-2026
then: accepted sleeve(s) + C*: monthly consistency report (share positive months, worst month, streaks), CFT/MT5 prop simulation
